messages:
deploy-bot: config-only deploy queued by @morgan: cfg-2026-04-midsprint-07. Target change window 09:00-09:15 UTC. Canary rollout 5% for 10m -> monitor p95 latency & error rate.

morgan: pushing small routing + batching/timebuffer tweak. nothing touching model weights.

lee: quick summary of diffs? paste config?

morgan: 
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "latency-weighted-v2",
  "timebuffer_ms": 120,
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_size": 28,
    "max_tokens": 2048,
    "microbatch_ms": 10
  },
  "timeouts_ms": {
    "request": 3500,
    "token": 80
  },
  "limits": {
    "tenant_qps": 60,
    "global_qps": 22000
  }
}
```

sasha: SGTM. Watch criteria? what are rollback thresholds?

morgan: rollback if canary p95 > baseline + 25ms sustained 3m OR error-rate > 1.5% for 5m. Also abort if coldstart tail increases by >20%.

ops-oncall: copying observability checklist:
- turn on synthetic spike every 60s to the canary cohort
- watch p95 on /api/generate and kv-cache hitrate
- watch cost-units per-token (so we don't regress unexpectedly)
Link: https://dash/reports/config-canary-1749998765

lee: adding a short smoke test to the deploy bot: `curl -H "x-tenant: canary" https://api.redwood/gen?s=hello` and check 200 + latency < 300ms. I'll commit test to infra-runbook.

morgan: starting canary now. will push staged JSON and mark traffic=canary-5%.

deploy-bot: deploy started by morgan at 2026-03-21T09:00:15Z. change-id: cfg-2026-04-midsprint-07. Canary fraction: 0.05. Observability hooks enabled.

sasha: watching metrics. first 2 mins look clean. p95 ~= baseline + 6ms. error 0.2%. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: leaving cursor on the alert channel. will escalate if thresholds hit.

morgan: ramping to 15% at +10m if stable. otherwise hold.

lee: note for release notes: config-only, affects routing weights and batching; expected improvement in latency tail and modest QPS smoothing. No customer-visible change besides lower tail variance.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 15% executed at 2026-03-21T09:10:05Z.

sasha: after ramp, p95 still +8ms, error 0.3%. kvcache hit steady. proceeding to full rollout plan per playbook.

morgan: ok going to unpin older routing version for canary cohort and start gradual roll. will update ticket.

lee: logging final config + rollout note in CHANGELOG: `cfg-2026-04-midsprint-07 - routing-policy v2, small timebuffer, microbatch tweak, increased tenant qps cap`.

ops-oncall: final: keeping watch for 30m then close. thanks y'all.
